notes.title: Episode 2 Update (2) - Indiegogo
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The crowdfunding campaign is going to be with Indiegogo! The start date is September 7 

Long story short: 
I have already wrote the story of the second episode (it will be the last, final episode), but I can't finish it without you! I am making this game alone and the development is really time/energy/money consuming. So for the second episode to be able to exist, I need your help! With a sucessful Indiegogo campaign you can make my dream come true! 

By supporting you also could get the game (with an epic-weird-humorous story) that you've been waiting for in your whole life!

 If you are interested, tell to your friends about the game and about the upcoming campaign!


 You can still sign up with your email adress, to be the first to get all the updates about the game:
sign up (or/and click on the "Follow" at the store page)

 I will post the link to the site before the campaign starts (here + at the official website + at the Facebook page)!


Don't forget: September 7!
